Acute onset peripheral neuropathy

• Any progressive weakness
• Unable to walk
• Unable to swallow or choking while drinking
water
• Evidence of respiratory distress like unable
to complete sentences, falling serial single
breath count, respiratory rate >20 or SaO2
levels < 95%
• Persistent tachycardia >100
• Fever
• Bowel and bladder involvement
